title: Retain or Reframe? A Computational Framework for the Analysis of Framing in News Articles and Reader Comments
reasoning: The paper uses 'Morality' as one of its core framing categories for analyzing news and comments. This category is explicitly defined as perspectives compelled by religion, ethics, or a sense of social responsibility. The paper benchmarks how models (including LLMs) identify these frames and analyzes how human readers reframe topics into religious or ethical categories.
